name: lr_minimal
description: Minimal left-right model between M_I and M_GUT: three generations of LR fermions (nu_R included), one complex bidoublet Phi(1,2,2,0), one complex right-handed triplet Delta_R(1,1,3,2). No GUT-scale threshold fields: every heavy state is assumed degenerate with M_GUT, so all threshold logs vanish.
